context.body: Prophets test what trust means · Habakkuk 2:1–5
context.label: Prophets test what trust means

observations.body: The prophet waits, receives a vision for an appointed time, and hears a contrast between the proud person and the righteous who lives by faithfulness.
observations.label: The righteous person lives by faithfulness

observations.body: The passage presents the righteous person lives by faithfulness as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: the righteous person lives by faithfulness

observations.body: The passage places faithfulness and life beside the righteous person lives by faithfulness.
observations.label: faithfulness and life

payload.posture: Read Habakkuk 2:1–5 as evidence about faith, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: Later quotations reuse the line in different arguments; the prophetic setting must remain visible.
payload.title: The righteous person lives by faithfulness
